chapterTitle: The Fait Accompli Strategy: Take Small Bites
coreMove: Build major change through a sequence of small moves that stay below the opponent's reaction threshold until the aggregate result is hard to reverse.
reversal: The strategy becomes manipulative when incrementalism hides the true cumulative aim or prevents informed consent from people who would object to the whole.
teachingEmphasis: treat the move as threshold management rather than magic
show how small steps aggregate into irreversible position
teach cumulative sequencing without romanticizing bad-faith creep
name the ethical boundary where incremental change becomes concealed coercion
